summary: Blue Gold Limited, a Cayman Islands metal-mining foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K containing notice and proxy statement for an extraordinary general meeting on November 17, 2026, to be held virtually. The EGM seeks revocation of July 24, 2026 resolutions that delegated reverse-split ratio discretion to the board, following a Cayman Deputy Registrar letter dated July 28, 2026 holding such delegation inconsistent with section 13 of the Companies Act. Fresh resolutions fix a 1-for-20 consolidation, conditional on related special resolutions. This is a routine meeting notice and capital-structure housekeeping matter, not a special situation.
